proof_summary: Take the counterexample \(n=33085221781504=2^{14}\cdot4409\cdot458009\), where \(4409\) and \(458009\) are prime. Multiplicativity of the divisor-sum function gives \(a(n)=2\sigma(n)-\sum_{d\mid n}\sigma(d)=2\cdot32767\cdot4410\cdot458010-65519\cdot4411\cdot458011=1\), although this \(n\) is neither \(1\) nor \(12\).
